steps.say: Energy is needed to make anything happen. Moving, lighting a bulb and cooking all need energy.
Energy is found in many things, such as sound, light, heat and moving objects.
Energy cannot be made or destroyed. It is transferred from one place or form to another.
A torch changes energy stored in a battery into light. Some energy also spreads out as heat.
Energy that spreads out as heat or sound is not useful for the job. We say it is wasted, but it is not lost.

check.prompt: Which of these needs energy to happen?

options.why: A ball that is not moving is not using energy to move.

options.text: a ball rolling along the ground
a closed book on a table

hints: Energy is needed for any movement.
Look for the thing that is moving.
check.explanation: Any movement or action needs energy.

check.prompt: A torch is switched on. Which is the best description of the energy changes?

options.text: Energy is made by the bulb.
options.why: Energy is not made. It is transferred.

options.text: Energy in the battery is transferred to light, and some also to heat.
Energy disappears when the light shines.

hints: Energy cannot be made or destroyed.
Think about where the energy comes from.
check.explanation: The battery stores energy. It is transferred to light, and some spreads out as heat.
